html:
The Chontal of Guerrero were an Indigenous people of the northern mountains of Guerrero in Mexico, in the area around Ixcateopan and Taxco. Chontal is a Nahuatl word for "foreigner", so it was given to several unrelated peoples; this group is poorly known and its language is extinct.

In the late 1400s the Aztec Triple Alliance conquered the region, which bordered the Purépecha kingdom to the west. Neighbours included the Cuitlatec, the Tlapanec and Nahuatl speakers (Nahua), whose language later replaced theirs.
